name: B0-minimax-m3
description: Weak cheap-model baseline (replaces Qwen3.6): stock Terminus-2 + MiniMax M3 (Atlas, Chat Completions, default thinking)
notes: On Atlas, non-streaming M3 calls repeat the body text (usage is double-counted too); streaming is fine. cah_stream_aggregate is a switch added by runner patch harbor-0.6.3-stream-aggregate.patch: it streams and reassembles a normal response, changing only the transport; model and decoding parameters are unchanged.
